info.title: GlianaAI
info.description: Pay-per-call AI models, live market data, SEC filings and identity APIs. Generative image, video, music, speech and LLM chat, plus crypto and FX rates, DEX liquidity, DeFi TVL, gas, US company fundamentals, SEC filings and insider trades, web search, document OCR and face matching. No signup or API key; each call is settled from the caller’s own wallet. Per-call prices: GET /v1/price?model=. Rate limit ~120 requests/min per IP — need more? contact@glianalabs.com. Not sure which endpoint you need? GET /v1/consult?intent=… is free. Agents: set up https://api.glianalabs.com/skill.md.
info.x-guidance: Browse models at GET /v1/models, get a model’s exact inputs at GET /v1/schema?model=, quote at GET /v1/price?model=, then POST /v1/infer with { model, ...modelInput }. You get a 402 with the price; pay from your wallet and retry. No API key — payment is the gate. Rails: POST /v1/infer settles over MPP (USDC on Tempo); for native x402 USDC on Base or Solana, POST /x402/{model}; the same tools and recipes also settle in USDC on Algorand at /a402/… and on BNB Smart Chain at /b402/… (see the per-endpoint x-payment-info for each path’s exact protocol). File inputs (image/video/audio, e.g. video-to-video video_uri) take a public URL — upload a local file (free) at POST /v1/media (≤40MB) and pass the returned url.

output.description: The model result, nested — NOT spread across the top level. Media models return { url, contentType, sizeBytes } where url is a stable /v1/media link we host; text models (STT, vision, JSON tools) return the provider shape, e.g. { text }.

post.summary: Generate chat completions with any LLM pay-per-call.
post.description:
**$0.0001–$60 per call**, depending on model and input. Exact price is returned in the 402 challenge before you pay, or up front from `GET /v1/price?model=`.

Drop-in for the OpenAI chat completions API: swap the base URL, keep your SDK. Pick any text model from GET /v1/models (category "text"). Billing is a pre-charged ceiling — (estimated input tokens + max_tokens) at the model’s per-1M rates — so set max_tokens to bound spend; the response returns real `usage`. Supports messages (required), max_tokens, temperature, top_p, stream: true (SSE, OpenAI chunk format), tools/tool_choice (OpenAI function calling — tool_calls + role:"tool" round-trip), and vision (content parts with image_url on vision-capable models). 402 → pay → retry. FILE INPUT: if the image is already on the web or your own storage, pass `image_url` — we fetch it server-side at datacenter speed, which is the fastest option by far. Sending it inline as `image_base64` is simplest and stores nothing anywhere, but base64 adds ~33% to the bytes and you pay your own upload speed, so it is best under ~1MB. For a large local file, upload the RAW bytes to `POST /v1/media` (free, ≤40MB) and pass the URL: same transfer as base64 minus the 33%, and identity endpoints delete the object as soon as they have read it.

max_tokens.description: Output cap — bounds the pre-charged ceiling. Default 1024.

tools.description: OpenAI function tools; response returns tool_calls.

200.description: OpenAI chat-completion body (+ costMicroUsd and a payment receipt).

402.description: Payment Required — pay the challenge and retry.

x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST "https://api.glianalabs.com/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"grok-4.3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize x402 in one sentence."}],"max_tokens":256}'
# Answers 402 with the price and where to pay. Pay from your wallet and
# retry the same request with the proof. Clients like mppx do this for you.

language.description: BCP-47 language code (e.g. "en", "zh", "pt-BR") or "auto" for automatic language detection. Required for both REST and WebSocket modes. Supported codes: auto, en, ar-EG, ar-SA, ar-AE, bn, zh, fr, de, hi, id, it, ja, ko, pt-BR, pt-PT, ru, es-MX, es-ES, tr, vi.

optimize_streaming_latency.description: Latency optimization for streaming synthesis. 0 (default): no optimization, best audio quality. 1: reduced first-chunk size for lower time-to-first-audio with minor quality tradeoff.

output_format.description: Output audio format. Defaults to MP3 at 24 kHz / 128 kbps when omitted.

speed.description: Speech speed multiplier. 1.0 is normal speed. Range: 0.7 to 1.5. Defaults to 1.0. Only used in WebSocket mode.

text.description: Text to convert to speech. Maximum 15,000 characters. Supports inline speech tags: [pause], [laugh], <whisper>…</whisper>, etc. Required for REST mode, mutually exclusive with websocket.

text_normalization.description: When true, normalizes written-form text into spoken-form before synthesis (e.g. "Dr." → "Doctor", "100" → "one hundred"). Defaults to false.

voice_id.description: Voice for synthesis. Defaults to "eve". Built-in voices: eve (energetic), ara (warm), rex (confident), sal (balanced), leo (authoritative). Custom voice IDs from /v1/tts/voices are also accepted. Case-insensitive — "Eve", "EVE", and "eve" are equivalent.

post.summary: Transcribe audio with grok-stt via x402.
post.description:
**$0.009006 per call.** Flat price, charged only on success.

Pay-per-call grok-stt (stt).

audio_format.description: Format hint for raw/headerless audio. Required for pcm, mulaw, alaw. Omit for container formats (mp3, wav, etc.) — xAI auto-detects them.

channels.description: Number of audio channels (2–8). Required only for multichannel raw audio; auto-detected for container formats.

diarize.description: When true, enables speaker diarization. Each word in the response includes a `speaker` integer identifying the detected speaker.

file.description: Audio file as a data URI (data:audio/...;base64,...) or an HTTPS URL the gateway fetches and uploads. Supported container formats: flac, mp3, mp4, m4a, mkv, ogg, opus, wav, aac. Raw formats (pcm, mulaw, alaw) also accepted — supply audio_format and sample_rate. Gateway-side size limit: 25 MB. Mutually exclusive with `url`. Pass a public URL; to use a local file, upload it (free) via POST /v1/media (≤40MB) and pass the returned url.

filler_words.description: When true, filler words (uh, um, er) are included in the transcript. Defaults to false — filler words are removed.

format.description: When true, enables Inverse Text Normalization — spoken numbers and currencies are converted to written form (e.g. "one hundred dollars" → "$100"). Requires language to be set.

keyterm.description: Key terms to bias transcription toward (e.g. product names, proper nouns). Each term up to 50 characters, max 100 terms. Sent as repeated form fields: keyterm=Term+One&keyterm=Term+Two.

language.description: Language code (e.g. "en", "fr", "de"). Used with format=true to enable Inverse Text Normalization. xAI transcribes in any language regardless — supplying this enables number/currency formatting in the transcript.

multichannel.description: When true, each audio channel is transcribed independently. Results are returned in the `channels` array. Requires channels ≥ 2.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate in Hz. Required when audio_format is set.

url.description: HTTPS URL of an audio file for xAI to fetch server-side. Mutually exclusive with `file` and `websocket`. No gateway-side size limit applies. Pass a public URL; to use a local file, upload it (free) via POST /v1/media (≤40MB) and pass the returned url.

post.summary: Get token swap and bridge quotes across chains.
post.description:
**$0.002000 per call.** Flat price, charged only on success.

Best routes to swap or bridge tokens across 60+ mainnets — { chain, from, to, amount, to_chain?, slippage_pct?, limit? }. amount is in whole tokens. Returns routes[] with receive, receive_min, value lost to fees and price impact, gas, fees and the DEXs or bridges used. Quote only: no wallet needed, nothing executed. The per-call price buys the quote; a service fee (service_fee_pct) is taken on-chain only if a swap executes. from.description: Token to sell: a symbol like USDC or ETH, or its contract address.

to.description: Token to buy: a symbol or contract address.

amount.description: How much of the from token to sell, in whole tokens, e.g. "10" or "0.25".

to_chain.description: Optional destination chain for a bridge, e.g. arbitrum or solana. Default: same as chain.

slippage_pct.description: Optional slippage tolerance in percent, 0.05 to 10. Default 0.5.

limit.description: Optional number of routes to return, 1 to 5. Default 3.

post.summary: List documents ranked by relevance to a query.
post.description:

Cross-encoder reranking for RAG — { query, documents, top_k? }. Reads the query with each document and orders them, most relevant first. Up to 100 documents (strings or { text } objects), each up to 4,000 characters. Returns results[] with index (position in your input), score and document. Use after a vector or keyword search, before prompting. Utility endpoint (not an AI model) — flat price, paid like /v1/infer (402, then pay and retry).

query.description: What the documents are being ranked against, up to 1,000 characters.

documents.description: Candidate texts to rank: up to 100 strings or { text } objects, each up to 4,000 characters.

top_k.description: Optional: return only the N most relevant documents. Default: all of them, ranked.

example.query: How do I get a refund?
documents: Our office is open Monday to Friday.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.

post.summary: Extract answers from an SEC filing with cited quotes.
post.description:
**$0.100000 per call.** Flat price, charged only on success.

A model reads a US public company filing and answers from it — { ticker, form?, accession?, question?, compare_to_prior? }. form defaults to 10-K; compare_to_prior also reads the previous filing of the same form and reports what changed. Returns answer, passages[] each matched verbatim against the filing, and links. Flat price for up to 700,000 characters of filing text; larger filings are refused before payment. Never investment advice. Utility endpoint (not an AI model) — flat price, paid like /v1/infer (402, then pay and retry).

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL. Case-insensitive.

form.description: Optional form to read, newest first: 10-K (default), 10-Q, 20-F, 40-F, 8-K, 6-K, DEF 14A, S-1 or F-1.

accession.description: Optional accession number of one specific filing, e.g. 0000320193-25-000079. Overrides form.

question.description: Optional question to answer from the filing, up to 500 characters. Omit for the most important disclosures.

compare_to_prior.description: Optional. true also reads the previous filing of the same form and reports what changed. Both must fit the 700,000-character cap together.

200.description: Result, plus the payment receipt headers.

example.question: What does the filing say about tariffs?
example.answer: Apple names new and higher tariffs as a risk to its costs and margins, and says trade measures can affect its supply chain and demand.

passages.quote: Tariffs and other trade measures can adversely affect the Company’s business.

402.description: Payment Required — pay the challenge and retry.

curl -X POST "https://api.glianalabs.com/v1/tools/filing-digest" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"ticker":"AAPL"}'
# Answers 402 with the price and where to pay. Pay from your wallet and
# retry the same request with the proof. Clients like mppx do this for you.
